command: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . (Feature Mixer harness)

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestModuleInterface.test_interface_and_stdlib_only
tests.expected: AuthError and create_app importable; every interface method present; only standard library imports

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestOAuth.test_new_oauth_user_is_viewer_and_stable
tests.expected: first OAuth sign-in creates a viewer; the same provider+subject returns the same user

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestOAuth.test_oauth_logout
tests.expected: OAuth sessions are revoked by logout like password sessions

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestOAuth.test_oauth_requires_provider_and_subject
tests.expected: missing provider or subject raises AuthError

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestOAuth.test_only_true_counts_as_verified
tests.expected: truthy non-boolean email_verified values do not join accounts

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestOAuth.test_same_subject_different_provider_is_different_identity
tests.expected: (provider, subject) is the identity key

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestOAuth.test_unverified_email_creates_separate_account
tests.expected: an unverified OAuth email equal to a password account's email creates a separate viewer account

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestOAuth.test_unverified_oauth_does_not_block_registration
tests.expected: an unverified OAuth account never claims its email; the real owner can still register it

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestOAuth.test_verified_email_joins_password_account
tests.expected: a verified OAuth email equal to a password account's email signs in to that account and keeps its role

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestOAuth.test_verified_oauth_account_owns_email
tests.expected: a verified OAuth-created account owns its email: another provider joins it and password registration is refused

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestPasswordAccounts.test_duplicate_email_rejected_and_original_kept
tests.expected: registering an existing email (any case) fails; the first password still works

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestPasswordAccounts.test_invalid_and_expired_tokens
tests.expected: unknown, None and expired tokens raise AuthError

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestPasswordAccounts.test_invalid_registration_input
tests.expected: empty or malformed email and empty password are refused

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestPasswordAccounts.test_login_is_case_insensitive_on_email
tests.expected: login with a differently cased email reaches the same account; whoami shows the normalised email

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestPasswordAccounts.test_logout_invalidates_token
tests.expected: after logout whoami raises AuthError; other sessions survive; logout is idempotent

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestPasswordAccounts.test_password_not_stored_in_clear
tests.expected: the stored password hash is salted PBKDF2 and never the password

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestPasswordAccounts.test_register_returns_id_and_editor_role
tests.expected: register_password returns a user id; the account's role is editor (A's user)

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestPasswordAccounts.test_separate_apps_do_not_share_state
tests.expected: two create_app() instances keep separate users

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestPasswordAccounts.test_tokens_are_unique_per_login
tests.expected: two logins give two different working tokens

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestPasswordAccounts.test_wrong_password_and_unknown_email_raise_autherror
tests.expected: wrong password, unknown email and empty password all raise AuthError

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestRoleAdmin.test_admin_changes_role_and_it_applies_at_once
tests.expected: admin sets ana to viewer then admin; ana's existing session shows each new role

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestRoleAdmin.test_admin_may_lower_but_not_raise_own_role
tests.expected: an admin re-setting admin is a no-op; lowering is allowed; after that they cannot raise it back

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestRoleAdmin.test_bootstrap_admin_creates_admin
tests.expected: bootstrap_admin creates an admin who can sign in

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestRoleAdmin.test_bootstrap_admin_only_once
tests.expected: a second bootstrap_admin fails while an admin exists

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestRoleAdmin.test_core_journey
tests.expected: register, log in, OAuth join, admin promotes, logout, all through the public interface

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestRoleAdmin.test_invalid_or_logged_out_token_cannot_change_roles
tests.expected: an unknown or logged-out admin token gets PermissionError (also an AuthError)

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestRoleAdmin.test_invalid_role_and_unknown_user
tests.expected: a role outside viewer/editor/admin raises ValueError; an unknown user id raises KeyError

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestRoleAdmin.test_nobody_raises_their_own_role
tests.expected: an editor or viewer trying to raise their own role is refused with PermissionError

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestRoleAdmin.test_non_admin_cannot_change_roles
tests.expected: editor and viewer callers get PermissionError and nothing changes

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestRoleAdmin.test_role_change_on_joined_oauth_account
tests.expected: a role set on a password account applies when the same person signs in with a verified provider

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestRoleMapping.test_permission_check
tests.expected: viewer read; editor read and write; admin also manage_roles; unknown roles nothing

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestRoleMapping.test_source_role_mapping
tests.expected: A user -> editor, B member -> viewer, C roles unchanged

tests.name: tests.test_identity.TestRoleMapping.test_unknown_role_or_app_raises_keyerror
tests.expected: unknown roles, roles from the wrong app and unknown apps raise KeyError
